column7: Judges and records one finalized stdio answer under the constant caller key STDIO_KEY, binding the identity whose tenant history every stdio read is checked against.
Judges one finalized stdio answer under STDIO_KEY without writing its tenant_read record, binding the caller key the cross-tenant verdict is keyed on.
Returns a backend notification for the stdio client only when the judge admits it, None when it is withheld or blocked (the rejection audited through admitted).
Returns a bridged server-to-client request only when the judge admits it; a blocked one is audited to the transparency log and returns None before the caller refuses its waiter.
Private helper deciding notification's answer: an admitted frame is returned unless the judge withheld it, and a blocked one is submitted to the rejection audit and returns None.
Builds an unjudged frame for gateway-built stdio content (parse errors, busy refusals); used for backend content it would silently skip the judge.
Projects a frame to the JSON the stdio writer emits and None for withheld, event and callback frames; the withhold decision is the judge's, and a Withheld payload carries no content to leak.
Builds the stdio judge from the firewall guard, rejection audit and transparency log; dropping the guard would silently turn judging off.
Hands dispatches the firewall their read scope notes under (stdio_notify read_scoped); a wrong answer would silently hide a dispatch's reads from the judge.

Reports whether frames are judged, which decides whether a request's params reach the judge (stdio_loop, stdio_notify); the decision is outbound::judges, and a wrong answer silently drops the request context.
